findings.subject: AGENTS.md rules vs checks
findings.summary: 7 of the 15 AGENTS.md rules (1 query-first, 2 compose-before-create, 3 contract-values, 6 quiet-secondary-actions, 7 one-boundary, 8 on-media-colors, 14 as-child-spreads-props) name no enforcing check and give no reason why not, and check:agents-md only verifies the block is in sync, so nothing holds the bar's U2 criterion.
findings.evidence: AGENTS.md:76-90; packages/cli/src/rules.mjs:19,35,40,45,80 (no `check` field); packages/cli/scripts/sync-agents-md.mjs:18-26 (diff only). check:craft `token-role` has no matching rule. Repo-level rules (changeset per published-package change, no brand icons in ui-react) have no CI gate.
findings.fix: Give every rule in rules.mjs either `check` or `unchecked: '<why>'` (e.g. contract-values: TypeScript unions reject other values; query-first: process rule, not checkable), render the reason in the generated block, and make check:agents-md fail on a rule with neither. Add a token-role rule (or fold it into rule 4's wording). Where cheap, add vibe-measure/craft lint for rule 6 (ghost without tone="muted" in toolbars) and rule 8.

findings.subject: packages/create and the starter
findings.summary: Generated starter apps get the docs-variant AGENTS.md (no `atom63 build`, no MCP) and no @atom63/cli dependency, justified by a README claim that the CLI is unpublished; @atom63/cli@beta is published.
findings.evidence: packages/create/src/generate.mjs:237 `agentsBlock({ variant: 'docs' })`; packages/create/README.md:26 'because the CLI is not published yet' and :65 '@atom63/mdx ... published'; sweep-r2/ds-registry-smoke.log '@atom63/cli@beta -> 0.1.0-beta.2', '@atom63/mdx@beta -> 0.4.0-beta.4'.
findings.fix: Add @atom63/cli as a devDependency of generated apps, switch the starter to the cli variant (keep the docs URLs as a fallback line), add a .mcp.json pointing at `pnpm exec atom63 mcp`, and delete the two stale README sentences.

findings.subject: apps/docs coverage and agent docs
findings.summary: Markdown twins (llms .md pages and the CLI docs index) drop live JSX examples, so components shown only in examples (InformBanner, InformDialog, InformSpotlight usage and props) never appear in what agents read.
findings.evidence: apps/docs/src/pages/pattern-inform.mdx:145-157 vs `pnpm -s atom63 docs pattern-inform | grep -c InformBanner` = 0 and `curl https://system.atom63.io/patterns/pattern-inform.md | grep -c InformBanner` = 0; shared converter apps/docs/vite-plugins/llms-txt.ts:196.
findings.fix: In mdxToMarkdown, emit the JSX inside ExampleContainer (and similar live-example wrappers) as a ```tsx fence instead of dropping it; add a test that every component tag used in a page's examples appears in its twin.

findings.subject: packages/cli (atom63 CLI and MCP)
findings.summary: Most subpath exports are 'documented' only by a page pointer that never names them; `atom63 api` for a JS export returns just an import line, with no props or signature.
findings.evidence: Names absent from all indexed docs/component Markdown: media/lightbox 27/28 (LightboxBackdrop...), inform/surfaces 13/14, widgets 26/35, mdx/primitives 22/28, ui-react/theme 20/26, mdx/lightbox 11/12. `pnpm -s atom63 api InformBanner` -> import line + 'Docs: atom63 docs pattern-inform' only.
findings.fix: Extend build-index to attach each React export's props (from the .d.ts / API report already generated) and its TSDoc summary to `atom63 api`; fail check:agent-index when a public export has neither a docs mention nor a TSDoc summary (with an allowlist for internal-looking constants, or move those to /preview).

findings.subject: packages/cli (atom63 CLI and MCP)
findings.summary: `atom63 api` gives the root import for all 29 preview APIs (e.g. DialogPrimitive), contradicting the quickstart rule to import them from @atom63/ui-react/preview, and does not flag them as preview.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 api DialogPrimitive` -> `import { DialogPrimitive } from '@atom63/ui-react'`; agent-index: 29 of 29 @atom63/ui-react/preview names also in the root module; docs/design-system/quickstart.md:86-97.
findings.fix: When a name is exported from /preview, answer with the /preview import and a 'preview: no stability promise' line; same in `atom63 component` usageExports.

findings.subject: packages/create and the starter
findings.summary: There is no fresh-install starter outside this repo: @atom63/create is private 0.0.0, so `pnpm create @atom63` fails, and consumers must assemble the Tailwind/shadcn/token wiring by hand.
findings.evidence: packages/create/package.json `"private": true`, version 0.0.0; packages/create/README.md:9 'once published'; docs/design-system/starter-plan.md:49 'private until release work resumes'.
findings.fix: Decide whether to publish @atom63/create on the beta tag with the other packages (check:starter already proves it against tarballs).

findings.subject: apps/docs coverage and agent docs
findings.summary: The published docs site, which starter agents are told to read, has no setup page (CSS import, Atom63Theme, Tailwind wiring), lists only 4 of 9 web packages and says nothing about the CLI, MCP or agent rules.
findings.evidence: apps/docs/src/pages/home.mdx:11-24 (one `pnpm add` line, packages table without mdx/inform/agent/widgets/cli); no page in apps/docs/src/pages imports '@atom63/ui-react/styles.css' with Atom63Theme setup; quickstart lives only at docs/design-system/quickstart.md.
findings.fix: Add a 'Get started' docs page from quickstart.md (install, CSS, theme, Tailwind/shadcn bridge, create starter) and a 'Build with agents' page (CLI, MCP config, the rules), and complete the home packages table.

findings.subject: packages/cli (atom63 CLI and MCP)
findings.summary: `atom63 docs component-<slug>` is not found although the published site and the starter AGENTS.md use those slugs; the error gives no pointer to `atom63 component <slug>`.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 docs component-dialog` -> 'No docs page "component-dialog". (docs.not_found)'; https://system.atom63.io/components/component-dialog.md -> 200; packages/cli/src/agents-md.mjs docsQueries cites component-dialog.md.
findings.fix: Resolve component-<slug> in `docs` to the component's Markdown, or return a `next: atom63 component <slug>` hint.

findings.subject: packages/cli (atom63 CLI and MCP)
findings.summary: Token search does not know the Tailwind/shadcn alias names the starter tells agents to use, and ranks shadow tokens above text colours for 'muted text'.
findings.evidence: `atom63 token muted-foreground` -> --a63-weather-muted-foreground, --a63-action-danger-foreground...; `atom63 token "muted text"` lists 4 shadow/brand tokens before --a63-text-secondary; mapping is packages/styles/src/compat/shadcn.css:26.
findings.fix: Index the compat aliases (muted-foreground -> --a63-text-secondary, utility text-muted-foreground) as synonyms of their target tokens.

findings.subject: packages/create and the starter
findings.summary: The shadcn path is proved only in CI, with unpinned shadcn@latest, and installs 1 of 20 Atom63 registry items.
